key.name: snap-threshold
key.description: Distance, in logical pixels, under which a window edge snaps to another edge.

key.name: snap-to-windows
key.description: Edges of the other visible windows on the same workspace and monitor attract the window.

key.name: snap-to-screen-edges
key.description: Edges of the monitor's work area (the screen minus the top bar and docks) attract the window.

key.name: snap-while-resizing
key.description: The dragged edges of a window being resized snap too.

key.name: spring-animation
key.description: The jump of a snap is caught up by a short spring. Off: the window jumps. GNOME's global "Animations" setting is honoured either way.

key.name: place-dropped-tabs
key.summary: Open dropped tabs where they are dropped
key.description: A tab dragged out of an application window and dropped on the desktop opens its window at the drop point, at the size of the window it came from.
